1f2nehu.description_en:
Hi,
Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to [LOCATION] and complete the delivery.
This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and unless you're super strong a heavy-duty tractor beam to shift it all.
I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this all behind us.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

zd8ft8.description_en:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.
Our pilot over at [LOCATION] is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.
If you have a ship that can carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.
This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.
Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll get it processed.
Good luck and take care,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
zd8ft8.description_zh:
最近越来越多繁荣公民的飞船遭到袭击，尽管我们竭尽全力保持贸易航线低调，仍不断有运输员在不法分子的攻击中丧生。

位于 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 的飞行员就是最新一位牺牲者。想到我们已损失如此之多，实在令人心痛；但只要还有人需要我们的帮助，我们就必须继续战斗。

如果你有一艘能装载 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱</EM4>的飞船，以及一把<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>，请立刻前往上述地点，把货物取回来。

这任务可不轻松。这位飞行员是我们最顶尖的成员之一，绝不会轻易被击倒。切勿低估这些不法分子，带上信得过的船员，彼此照应、互相掩护。

取回货物后，请将其送至 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯处，我会安排后续处理。

祝你好运，务必小心，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

1g9jlta.description_en:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.
Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.
Make your way to [LOCATION] whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 10 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
1g9jlta.description_zh:
恭喜完成八节课程的第三部分。

优秀飞行员都明白：真正的威胁往往藏于暗处。场景 4 将重点训练如何应对隐形目标。课程结束时，你会深刻体会到雷达在识别敌情时的重要性——本次你将同时遭遇常规飞船和隐身飞船的围剿。

准备就绪后前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> ，切记时刻关注雷达动向。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证</EM4>。

实战技巧：
- 反隐侦查 - 主动扫描周围空域可能发现隐藏目标，随时做好遭遇突发敌情的准备。

祝你好运，
教练吉利

关于吉利飞行学院
教练卢卡斯·“吉利”·巴拉姆斯科曾在六个飞行中队服役，拥有超过十年的教学经验。无论是零飞行经验的学生，还是希望提升技能的专业人士，吉利飞行学院都提供多种课程，帮助“开启你的飞行生涯”。

1p8wqe2.description_en:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.
We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.
Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.
And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

- 斯托斯

I've got a beacon at [LOCATION] and this one's a bit more complicated than usual. Got small convoy of ships requesting [FUELTYPE]. Impressive coordination and lack of planning to all need refueling at the same time.
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hopefully since the area they're in is pretty safe, there shouldn't be too much trouble lurking, but these days you never know. Wouldn't hurt to get them back flying again as quick as you're able.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

所幸他们所在的区域安全一些，不太会有麻烦潜伏，但如今世事难料。还是尽快让他们恢复航行比较好。

Hiya,
Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.
Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.
As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

至于要开哪艘船，你需要能搬得动 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱</EM4> 的飞船。

[SIGN_OFF]
